simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עוּר (H5782) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 80 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עוּר (ʻûwr) means to wake (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 5 26.

definitions.usage: (a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), × master, raise (up), stir up (self).
